run2: Research fixture additionally assumed section heading equals source title; corrected fixture only; original E2E input and business support checks retained.

provenance: Run1 used isolated candidate v1; run2 and run3 used candidate v2.
Run3 frontend assets were copied from exact image into the retained isolated frontend; candidate-frontend-overlay.json records all hashes.
